snippet.title: Half Grip - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam page: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4163270?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=reveal



Get hooked on this brutal one-armed rogue-like combat racing game where every action is a gamble. 
Steer, shoot and reload: each split-second counts as you compete against armed rivals across atmospheric tracks rendered in harsh pixelated detail.
